filters.piston_immovable: excluded (bedrock cannot be pushed; in Java anything with a block entity cannot either, which removes blast_furnace, furnaces, chests, hoppers, shulker boxes)
filters.slabs: allowed -- two stack into a full cube
filters.face_var: <= 3.0: every face must look the same
filters.within_texture_std: reported only, NOT a filter -- diorite is approved and is mottled (std 34.7)

method: lightness-discounted saturation + inter-face uniformity + approved bonus + optimal ordered assignment
